definition{
  name: width,
  parameters: [band : Band],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (if ((project band low) <=? (project band high)) then (ctor Option.some [Nat] (prim subtract (project band high) (project band low) : Nat)) else (ctor Option.none [Nat]))
}

definition{
  name: checkedMidpoint,
  parameters: [band : Band],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (match (if (((project band low) + (project band high)) <? 4294967296) then (ctor Option.some [Nat] ((project band low) + (project band high))) else (ctor Option.none [Nat]))
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Nat])
    | Option.some sum => (ctor Option.some [Nat] (prim quotient sum 2 0 : Nat)))
}
